description: A Black feminist/womanist storytelling methodology in which learners deconstruct dominant narratives about who belongs in a domain, analyze whose perspectives those narratives silence, and reconstruct alternative narratives grounded in their own lived experience.
title: Womanist Restorying

description: The review organizes the factors enhancing incidental L2 vocabulary acquisition into three aspects: the word itself, the reading text, and the learners.
title: Three-factor framework of word, text, and learner factors affecting incidental L2 vocabulary acquisition

description: Dimension 4 argues the world is best conceived as a system of interconnected elements rather than a machine or organism.
title: The world as an interconnected system: replacing simple cause and effect with complex interaction
